layers.front-door: Front door: for anyone on the team
layers.ladder: The ladder: route corrections, set up, and measure
layers.scale: Scale: many agents and the outer loop

plugins.trust-ladder: This kit's own plugin: the ladder, lint packs, templates, the compat layer, and the skills for non-engineers.
plugins.pstack: The plugin the talk and both posts are about. Vendored with the principles, playbooks, agents, and the benny automation pack. `make-bot-ui` is left out: it builds pages for the upstream editor's Grok Bot.
plugins.team-workflows: pstack routes to its `control-ui`, `control-cli`, and `deslop`; the talk's CI and review workflow lives here.
plugins.thermos: The review panel team-workflows's `thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review` belongs to.
plugins.continual-learning: Turns transcripts into AGENTS.md updates: the rules layer learning on its own. Its cadence hook runs in Claude Code and Codex.
plugins.cli-for-agent: How to design the CLI a verification skill wraps, from Pt. 1's control-app.
plugins.agent-compatibility: Scores how agent-friendly a repository is; `trust-audit` uses it.
plugins.advisor: A second opinion before a risky step, from a fresh run of your own model. Its end-of-turn reminder runs in Claude Code and Codex.
plugins.teaching: Learning paths, so designers, marketers, and founders can build skills with agents.
